bootstrap.unit: Whole paired market seed; shared index draws across all four primary strata

defaultSelection.scope: Presentation default selected without inspecting outcomes; no scientific preregistration is implied.

meta.scope: Two mask conditions in one economic calibration. Independent own-profit masked tabular Q learners, finite fixed budget and declared initializations. Actual terminal-clock/history frozen-policy cycle is primary; common fresh-cap starts and all-state graphs are secondary. No unrestricted capability reference, equilibrium or emergent-collusion claim. Independent checkpoint/graph/probe validation is not a complete training replay.
meta.previewScope: Truncated128-execution actual-terminal frozen-policy preview only; exact complete-cycle means are separately audited. Q/policy binaries are omitted. Startup-only terminal continuation receives no new cap. The browser performs no optimization.
meta.developmentAssistance: Codex development and AI-agent auditing assistance disclosed; no language-model/chat/API seller calls.
meta.provenance: All compact rows byte-match full raw-evidence-gated read-only analysis regeneration; exact saved-weight endpoint signs and approximate marginal whole-seed bootstrap intervals remain distinct.

allStates.scope: Frozen no-update/no-exploration deterministic policies. Exact rationals of saved finite numerical rewards; preview is truncated and does not replace exact cycle means; all-state unvisited/default policies are structural diagnostics, not training occupation or competence.

controllerFloor.scope: Own inherited finite numerical game only: cap-first minimum nonempty prefix mean bounds every activation-average horizon, and the cycle mean is its long-run floor. Continuous selected-period identity transfers no target guarantee.
controllerFloor.displayScope: Long-run display for the saved terminal phase/history; this is not generally a fresh-cap prefix

checkpoints.previewScope: First128 actual-terminal frozen-policy executions; truncated preview, not a cycle-mean estimator
